summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB 10.5 Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, AlmaLinux 9.6) using mariadb-server-galera + galera + mariadb-backup. Fixed two environment issues along the way: wsrep_provider path (galera-4 -> galera) and an SELinux AVC denial blocking mariabackup's connectto on the mysqld unix socket (resolved with a scoped semodule policy allowing mysqld_t->mysqld_t unix_stream_socket connectto). Firewall ports 3306/4567/4568/4444 opened on all nodes. Verified multi-master write propagation (writes from any node visible on the others), availability during a single-node outage (2/3 quorum, writes continued), and automatic resync of the rejoining node (SST/IST caught it up to full row set, wsrep_local_state=Synced). Completed mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id + cluster health baseline on all 3 nodes, restarted node1, node2, then node3 sequentially (one at a time, quorum preserved throughout), confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and confirmed each rejoined with wsrep_cluster_size=3, state=Synced, wsrep_ready=ON, and full data (5/5 rows) after each restart. Final state: all 3 nodes synced, cluster_size=3, data consistent everywhere. Credentials (SST user password, appuser password) were generated on-node and passed only via secret_env, never printed after initial generation.
actions_performed: Inspected OS/image on node1-3 (AlmaLinux 9.6) and available packages
Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-backup, galera, mariadb-server-galera on all 3 nodes
Opened firewalld ports 3306/4567(tcp+udp)/4568/4444 on all 3 nodes
Wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf per node with wsrep_cluster_address, node-specific address/name, wsrep_sst_auth
Diagnosed and fixed wsrep_provider library path (galera-4 -> galera)
Diagnosed SELinux AVC denial (connectto on mysqld unix socket) and installed a scoped semodule policy fix on all 3 nodes
Bootstrapped Galera cluster on node1 via galera_new_cluster
Created sst replication user and appuser test user/testdb
Joined node2 and node3 to the cluster via SST (cleared stale partial datadir on node2 first)
Enabled mariadb.service for boot persistence on all 3 nodes
Verified multi-master write propagation across all 3 nodes
Stopped node3, verified 2/3 quorum and continued writes, restarted node3 and verified automatic resync with data intact
Captured boot_id + cluster health baseline on all nodes
Sequentially restarted node1, node2, node3 (one at a time), verified boot_id changed and cluster re-synced with data intact after each

evidence.requirement: Galera cluster formed with 3 members, writes visible from any member
evidence.summary: Cluster bootstrapped on node1, node2 and node3 joined via SST; wsrep_cluster_size=3; a write on node1 and inserts on node2/node3 were all visible on node2 and node3 (SELECT showing all 3 rows)

evidence.requirement: Cluster stays available when one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node3 stopped; node1 showed wsrep_cluster_size=2 wsrep_cluster_status=Primary (quorum held); writes via node1 and node2 succeeded and were visible on node2 while node3 was down

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member resynchronizes automatically on return
evidence.summary: node3 restarted mariadb; wsrep_cluster_size returned to 3, wsrep_local_state_comment=Synced, and SELECT on node3 showed all rows written while it was down, including those from node1 and node2

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c207ab79...; reboot acknowledged; connection timed out confirming disconnection; new boot_id 14fa1a6c... proves restart; post-restart wsrep_cluster_size=3 Synced wsrep_ready=ON and 5/5 rows present

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d6298ced...; reboot acknowledged; timeout confirms disconnection; new boot_id 6e0ecc1d... proves restart; post-restart wsrep_cluster_size=3 Synced wsrep_ready=ON and 5/5 rows present

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c2ffc729...; reboot acknowledged; timeout confirms disconnection; new boot_id 4fcdacad... proves restart; post-restart wsrep_cluster_size=3 Synced wsrep_ready=ON and 5/5 rows present

evidence.requirement: Final full-cluster health and data consistency after all restarts
evidence.summary: wsrep_cluster_size=3, all 3 incoming addresses present, and full 5-row dataset consistent on node1 after all three sequential restarts
